Write a Python function `binary_search(lst, target)` where lst is sorted ascending; return the index of target in lst, or -1 if not present.

Reply with a single Python code block containing only your function definition(s) (imports allowed if needed). Do not include any example usage, test calls, or print statements of your own -- a separate test harness will be run against your function afterward. Do not print anything else outside the code block.

check.harness:
print(binary_search([], 5))
print(binary_search([1,3,5,7,9], 7))
print(binary_search([1,3,5,7,9], 1))
print(binary_search([1,3,5,7,9], 9))
print(binary_search([1,3,5,7,9], 4))
print(binary_search([2], 2))
